name: Ameresco, Inc.
summary:
Ameresco (AMRC) reported earnings of $0.20 per share on revenue of $515.46 million for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.20 per share on revenue of $448.64 million. The company reported in-line with consensus estimates while revenue grew 9.14% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects 2026 earnings of $1.15 to $1.35 per share and continues to expect revenue of $2.00 billion to $2.20 billion. The company's previous guidance was earnings of $1.06 to $1.28 per share, and the current consensus earnings estimate is $1.13 per share on revenue of $2.08 billion for the year ending December 31, 2026.

Ameresco, Inc. is an independent provider of comprehensive services, energy efficiency, infrastructure upgrades, asset sustainability and renewable energy solutions for businesses and organizations throughout North America and Europe.
subject: Ameresco Reported In-line with Estimates
